## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or enhancement
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `perf`: Performance optimization
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavioral change
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `test`: Test cases addition or modification
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, build pipeline, or CI changes

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/path-ioc/path-ioc/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
- [ ] Local tests pass (`pnpm test:all`).
- [ ] Production build succeeds (`pnpm build`).
- [ ] Documentation builds without errors (`pnpm docs:build`).
- [ ] I have generated a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if this PR introduces a package version change.
